cases.sentence: Сказал безумец в ___ своем, Нет Бога.
cases.translation: The fool said in his heart, 'There is no God.'
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with the location of thoughts governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Они развратились, гнусны их ___, нет делающего добро.
cases.translation: They have corrupted themselves, their deeds are abominable.
cases.explain: Дела is the subject of the adjective 'гнусны' (abominable), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Бог взирает с ___ на людей, чтобы увидеть.
cases.translation: God looks down from heaven upon mankind.
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Is there anyone who understands, who seeks God?
cases.explain: Бога is the direct object of the verb 'ищущий' (seeking), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Неужели не вразумятся делающие зло те, кто поедает мой народ, как ___, и Бога не призывает?
cases.translation: Will not the workers of iniquity learn, those who devour my people as bread?
cases.explain: Хлеб is the direct object of the verb 'поедает' (devour), taking the accusative case (same as nominative for inanimate nouns).

cases.sentence: Там их охватит страх, где нечего бояться, Бог разметает кости ополчающихся на ___.
cases.translation: There they were seized by fear where there was no fear; God will scatter the bones of those who rise against you.
cases.explain: Тебя is the direct object of the preposition 'на' (against) in the phrase 'ополчающихся на тебя', taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: О, кто дал бы ___ спасение Израилю?
cases.translation: Oh, that salvation would come to Zion for Israel!
cases.explain: Сиону is the indirect object receiving salvation, taking the dative case.

cases.sentence: Когда Бог восстановит ___ свой, пусть ликует Иаков и радуется Израиль.
cases.translation: When God brings back His people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.
cases.explain: Народ is the direct object of the verb 'восстановит' (restore), taking the accusative case (same as nominative for inanimate nouns).

reading.ru: Сказал безумец в сердце своем, Нет Бога.
reading.question: What does the fool say in his heart?
reading.explain: Сказал безумец в сердце своем, Нет Бога — The fool said in his heart, 'There is no God.'

reading.ru: Они развратились, гнусны их дела, нет делающего добро.
reading.question: What happened to people according to this verse?
options: They corrupted themselves and their deeds are abominable
reading.correct: They corrupted themselves and their deeds are abominable
reading.explain: Они развратились, гнусны их дела — They have become corrupt, their deeds are abominable.

reading.ru: Бог взирает с небес на людей, чтобы увидеть, есть ли понимающий, ищущий Бога.
reading.question: Why does God look down from heaven upon mankind?
options: To see if anyone understands and seeks Him
reading.correct: To see if anyone understands and seeks Him
reading.explain: Бог взирает с небес... чтобы увидеть, есть ли понимающий, ищущий Бога — God looks down to see if anyone understands and seeks Him.

reading.ru: Неужели не вразумятся делающие зло те, кто поедает мой народ, как хлеб, и Бога не призывает?
reading.question: What is the psalmist asking about the evildoers?
options: Will they not learn and stop devouring his people like bread
Will they become stronger and richer
Will they lead nations in righteousness
Will they find peace and rest
reading.correct: Will they not learn and stop devouring his people like bread
reading.explain: The rhetorical question asks if the evildoers who devour his people like bread and don't call on God will not be taught.

reading.ru: Бог разметает кости ополчающихся на тебя, Их покроет позор, потому что отверг их Бог.
reading.question: What does God do to those who rise up against the psalmist?
options: God scatters their bones and covers them with shame because He rejects them
God makes them rich and powerful
reading.correct: God scatters their bones and covers them with shame because He rejects them
reading.explain: Бог разметает кости ополчающихся на тебя... отверг их Бог — God scatters the bones of those who rise against you; He rejects them.

reading.ru: О, кто дал бы Сиона спасение Израилю, когда Бог восстановит свой народ, пусть ликует Иаков и радуется Израиль.
reading.question: What is the psalmist's prayer concerning Zion and Israel?
options: That salvation would come to Zion and Israel, and when God restores His people, Jacob and Israel would rejoice
That Zion would become a great military power
That the enemies of Israel would be destroyed
That Israel would never face any hardship
reading.correct: That salvation would come to Zion and Israel, and when God restores His people, Jacob and Israel would rejoice
reading.explain: The psalmist prays for Zion's salvation and Israel's restoration, when God's people will rejoice.
